headline: AI stocks slide after major CEOs unite to urge slowdown
detail: This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip portfolio. Negative sentiment on AI could lead to further pressure on names like SMH, QQQ, and even CRWD. Leveraged ETFs like SOXL will amplify these moves, increasing your margin risk.
rec: Consider trimming positions in leveraged tech/chip ETFs like SOXL or SPAL, or even SMH, to reduce exposure to this negative sentiment.

headline: U.S. Treasury yields are steady as 10-year closes in on 5% ahead of Fed rates decision
detail: High and rising Treasury yields make growth stocks, especially tech, less attractive as future earnings are discounted more heavily. With the 10-year nearing 5% and a Fed decision looming, this creates a challenging environment for your tech-heavy, margin-leveraged portfolio.
rec: No immediate trade based solely on this, but watch the Fed decision closely. Be prepared to adjust stops or trim if yields break higher, as this would put more pressure on your tech holdings.
